◆ SCT_CONFIG_UNIFY [1/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_UNIFY ( x)

UNIFY - SCT Operation 0b0..Dual counter. The SCT operates as two 16-bit counters named COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H. 0b1..Unified counter. The SCT operates as a unified 32-bit counter.

UNIFY - SCT Operation 0b0..Dual counters, COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H 0b1..Unified counter

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE [1/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE ( x)

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including all counters and counter prescalers. 0b01..Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode. 0b10..SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including all counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode. 0b11..Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock mode 0b01..Sampled System Clock mode 0b10..SCT Input Clock mode 0b11..Asynchronous mode

UNIFY - SCT Operation 0b0..Dual counters, COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H 0b1..Unified counter

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE [2/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE ( x)

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock mode 0b01..Sampled System Clock mode 0b10..SCT Input Clock mode 0b11..Asynchronous mode

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including all counters and counter prescalers. 0b01..Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode. 0b10..SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including all counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode. 0b11..Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CKSEL [2/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CKSEL ( x)

CKSEL - SCT Clock Select 0b0000..Rising edges on input 0 0b0001..Falling edges on input 0 0b0010..Rising edges on input 1 0b0011..Falling edges on input 1 0b0100..Rising edges on input 2 0b0101..Falling edges on input 2 0b0110..Rising edges on input 3 0b0111..Falling edges on input 3 0b1000..Rising edges on input 4 0b1001..Falling edges on input 4 0b1010..Rising edges on input 5 0b1011..Falling edges on input 5 0b1100..Rising edges on input 6 0b1101..Falling edges on input 6 0b1110..Rising edges on input 7 0b1111..Falling edges on input 7

CKSEL - SCT Clock Select. The specific functionality of the designated input/edge is dependent on the CLKMODE bit selection in this register. 0b0000..Rising edges on input 0 0b0001..Falling edges on input 0 0b0010..Rising edges on input 1 0b0011..Falling edges on input 1 0b0100..Rising edges on input 2 0b0101..Falling edges on input 2 0b0110..Rising edges on input 3 0b0111..Falling edges on input 3 0b1000..Rising edges on input 4 0b1001..Falling edges on input 4 0b1010..Rising edges on input 5 0b1011..Falling edges on input 5 0b1100..Rising edges on input 6 0b1101..Falling edges on input 6 0b1110..Rising edges on input 7 0b1111..Falling edges on input 7

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE [3/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE ( x)

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock mode 0b01..Sampled System Clock mode 0b10..SCT Input Clock mode 0b11..Asynchronous mode

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including all counters and counter prescalers. 0b01..Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode. 0b10..SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including all counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode. 0b11..Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.

◆ SCT_CONFIG_UNIFY [4/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_UNIFY ( x)

UNIFY - SCT Operation 0b0..Dual counter. The SCT operates as two 16-bit counters named COUNTER_L and COUNTER_H. 0b1..Unified counter. The SCT operates as a unified 32-bit counter.

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE [4/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CLKMODE ( x)

CLKMODE - SCT Clock Mode 0b00..System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the entire SCT module including all counters and counter prescalers. 0b01..Sampled System Clock Mode. The system clock clocks the SCT module, but the counter and prescalers are only enabled to count when the designated edge is detected on the input selected by the CKSEL field. The minimum pulse width on the selected clock-gate input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the high-performance, sampled-clock mode. 0b10..SCT Input Clock Mode. The input/edge selected by the CKSEL field clocks the SCT module, including all counters and prescalers, after first being synchronized to the system clock. The minimum pulse width on the clock input is 1 bus clock period. This mode is the low-power, sampled-clock mode. 0b11..Asynchronous Mode. The entire SCT module is clocked directly by the input/edge selected by the CKSEL field. In this mode, the SCT outputs are switched synchronously to the SCT input clock - not the system clock. The input clock rate must be at least half the system clock rate and can be the same or faster than the system clock.

◆ SCT_CONFIG_CKSEL [4/4]

#define SCT_CONFIG_CKSEL ( x)

CKSEL - SCT Clock Select. The specific functionality of the designated input/edge is dependent on the CLKMODE bit selection in this register. 0b0000..Rising edges on input 0 0b0001..Falling edges on input 0 0b0010..Rising edges on input 1 0b0011..Falling edges on input 1 0b0100..Rising edges on input 2 0b0101..Falling edges on input 2 0b0110..Rising edges on input 3 0b0111..Falling edges on input 3 0b1000..Rising edges on input 4 0b1001..Falling edges on input 4 0b1010..Rising edges on input 5 0b1011..Falling edges on input 5 0b1100..Rising edges on input 6 0b1101..Falling edges on input 6 0b1110..Rising edges on input 7 0b1111..Falling edges on input 7
